ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted_avg_clamp_entropy_var_reciprocal_safe
ir.intuition: Same as original but safely handles missing entropy keys by substituting zero tensors, preserving original loss behavior and stability.
ir.pseudocode:
x = clamp(alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + lambda * advantage_gap, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
clamped_loss = clamp(weighted_loss, 0, max_clip)
loss_mean = sum(clamped_loss) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', zeros)
entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', zeros)
entropy_products = entropy_w * entropy_l
entropy_mean = sum(weight * entropy_products) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy_diff = entropy_products - entropy_mean
entropy_variance = sum(weight * entropy_diff^2) / (sum(weight) + eps)
entropy_reg = lambda_entropy / (1 + entropy_variance + eps)
final_loss = loss_mean + entropy_reg
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-12
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    lambda_entropy = float(extra.get('lambda', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('lambda', 0.1)))
    max_clip = float(extra.get('max_clip', 10.0))

    entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape))
    entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', lpw.new_zeros(lpw.shape))

    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(lambda_entropy, advantage_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    clamped_loss = ops.clamp(weighted_loss, 0.0, max_clip)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(clamped_loss), ops.add(ops.sum(weight), eps))

    entropy_products = ops.mul(entropy_w, entropy_l)
    entropy_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(weight, entropy_products)), ops.add(ops.sum(weight), eps))
    entropy_diff = ops.sub(entropy_products, entropy_mean)
    entropy_variance = ops.div(ops.sum(ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(entropy_diff, entropy_diff))), ops.add(ops.sum(weight), eps))
    entropy_reg = ops.div(lambda_entropy, ops.add(ops.add(ops.ones_like(entropy_variance), entropy_variance), eps))

    final_loss = ops.add(loss_mean, entropy_reg)
    return final_loss
